n: aiEDU Indigitize Snapshots and Rithm Project Snapshots
t: Two variant sets of aiEDU AI Snapshots for Indigenous classrooms and high school ELA.
steps: Find the aiEDU Snapshots and look for the Indigitize and Rithm Project sets.
